subject: C31
required_fixes: R1 (high) — crates/desktop-core/src/features.rs:221 persists Rotation.issued_by, and authority.rs:3260 restores it unchanged. Operations::new resets the numeric op-N counter (runtime.rs:153-172), while rotation_domain.rs:342-370 associates a held secret with a rotation using only that restored operation string. After relaunch, a new issuance for another application or a Gateway key can reuse the ID: the old rotation then appears Issued and offers Reveal for the unrelated secret. Acknowledging the old rotation also passes the stale ID to forget_secret_of (rotation_domain.rs:300; authority.rs:3797-3798), discarding the unrelated key. Keep disclosure references session-bound and tied to the exact originating issuance; persisted rotation facts must not restore this linkage. Acceptance: persist an unfinished rotation, restart, deliberately reuse its former operation ID for a different key issuance, and prove the old rotation remains Resumed with no Reveal, its acknowledgement/exit cannot forget the new key, and each secret remains revealable only from its own current result.

R2 (medium) — apps/desktop/src/v2/admin/review-sheet.tsx:89-93 hides the workbench whenever a rotation operation settles, but :288-293 shows its failure only when no rotation exists. Starting from Resumed, Issue another key followed by a rejected or NotSent Version leaves the previous rotation intact, so the rejection disappears and the sheet silently returns to the previous Resumed panel. An independent in-memory production-component probe reproduced no workbench, applied result, alert or rejection text after a rejected reissuance. Present the latest failed issuance separately from the retained rotation state. Acceptance: a failed second issuance displays its sanitized reason and safe explicit recovery, preserves the previous key/reminder, and sends no automatic mutation.

R3 (low) — apps/desktop/src/features/runtime/runtime-view.tsx:449-461 renders the new blocked, monitor-only and unnamed topic verdicts as text-only PillBox children. The consumed presentation PillBox renders a span without an icon. These verdicts omit the icon required alongside colour and words by UI v2 invariant I9. Acceptance: the production Playground renders an appropriate icon and explicit verdict text for each topic verdict in both directions, with regression assertions against this path rather than only the generic Verdict component.
